External state update: Gerrit change 2624 was submitted while its advisory follow-up was being prepared and is now merged on main as 0fbbe517e360. Gerrit therefore rejected the attempted patchset 2 because the change was closed.

The merged commit contains the AGENTS.md/runbook remediation. The two detector-pointer corrections and regression assertion remain to land. Recovery: refresh the unchanged plan against current origin/main, create a fresh follow-up worktree/commit containing only those two-file changes, and send it through the normal LLM-Review and Verified gates.
